messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered for region az7 — control-plane heartbeats missing for 3/5 master nodes. Auto-alert sent to on-call rotation.

pagerduty: Pager Duty — P1 alert created: 'az7 control-plane heartbeat loss' — incident: PD-78321. Notified: Alice, Bob.

Alice (SRE): acked via PD. I'm on it. Starting a quick blast-radius check.

Bob (Platform): any telemetry on request error spikes / latency?

Carol (Runtime): seeing increased 5xx from gateway -> serving layer in az7. Error rate jumping ~18% over baseline over last 2m. Metrics: request_success_percent down to ~82% for az7.

Dave (Support): getting customer reports: 3 SEVs from enterprise customers in eu-west routing to az7. Support triage opened TICKET-1294, sent initial note to customers.

Eve (Ops): can we run the failover policy? Route-policy 'region-fallback-v2' should divert new sessions to az3/az2 within 30s.

Alice (SRE): executing traffic divert now. Command: 
```
./infractl routing divert --from=az7 --to=az3,az2 --weight=100 --policy=region-fallback-v2
```

Alice (SRE): divert command returned accepted. Watching routing convergence.

Carol (Runtime): enabling fallback model variants for az7 traffic in case serving nodes remain degraded (quantized variant q6f). Patch applied to fallback-policy in 2s.

incident-bot: Automated action: 'fallback-variant-activate' executed for model-suite 'gpt-open-xxl' in az7.

Bob (Platform): autoscaler shows capacity scale-up requests for az7 failing with RPC errors to control-plane. Likely control-plane partitioned. We should spin new dedicated nodes in other AZs as fallback — but divert already should help.

Alice (SRE): confirmed egress routing now ~95% to az3/az2. Error rate in user-facing load has dropped to ~6% within 90s.

Carol (Runtime): check logs snippet for heartbeat errors: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:21Z] master-heartbeat: missed-last-3 from node az7-m-02
[2026-03-15T12:34:22Z] master-heartbeat: missed-last-3 from node az7-m-04
[2026-03-15T12:34:25Z] controlplane-api: rpc timeout to etcd-proxy az7-etcd-1 (deadline exceeded)
```

Eve (Ops): network fabric telemetry shows packet drops on az7 leaf 12 -> spine 3 around 12:33:40Z, transient but high. Could be switched flapping.

Dave (Support): posting customer update: "We're aware of increased errors for some requests routed through az7. We've automatically diverted traffic to healthy zones; mitigations are in progress. We'll follow up in 30 minutes." :thumbsup:

Olivia (PM): any impact on SLAs or queued work? Need ETA for full recovery.

Alice (SRE): ETA for degraded nodes: unknown until network fabric stabilize. For customer-facing throughput we have mitigation in place (divert + fallback models). Recommend keeping PD as P1 and keep rotation until control-plane heartbeats restored and scale operations validated.

Carol (Runtime): running canary traffic backtests to validate model parity on fallback variants. Early checks: latency + token cost ~+12% but quality checks pass for our eval prompts.

Bob (Platform): I'm handing off to Eve (network lead) for fabric-level remediation. Eve — please coordinate with infra team and hardware vendor.

Eve (Ops): on it. Opening fabric ticket FAB-5477 and paging spine+switch oncall.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: no additional acks from second-tier in last 2m; escalating PD-78321 to network oncall.

Alice (SRE): handoff note -> oncall network + platform. continuing to monitor: suggested playbooks executed: routing divert, fallback variant enable, customer notifications, scale attempts deferred until control-plane healthy.

Dave (Support): customers acknowledging update. No new critical tickets so far. Monitoring social mentions.

Eve (Ops): vendor confirms scheduled maintenance was NOT applied but observed flapping, running remote diagnostics now.

Carol (Runtime): rolling restart of az7 serving processes pending control-plane health. Holding until control-plane writeable.

Alice (SRE): control-plane heartbeats recovered on 2/5 masters at 12:39:30Z, full cluster quorum restored at ~12:42:05Z.

Bob (Platform): beginning controlled re-admit of az7. Steps: 1) re-enable autoscaler for az7 2) drain diverted traffic weight by 20% increments 3) monitor errors/latency.

Alice (SRE): re-admit initiated. Reducing divert to 60% now.

Carol (Runtime): serving error-rate in az7 back to ~3% during re-admit. No new regressions in the next 2 minutes.

Dave (Support): updating customers: "Traffic has been partially re-routed back to az7 after stability checks. We will continue to monitor and post a final incident summary once validated."

Olivia (PM): good. please capture timeline and action items for postmortem. Key asks: why network fabric flapped and why autoscaler couldn't create fallback capacity earlier.

incident-bot: Incident PD-78321 acknowledged closed by Alice (SRE) in PagerDuty at 12:55Z. Marking as resolved for immediate customer impact; follow-up postmortem required.

Alice (SRE): creating postmortem ticket PM-2219. Assigning owners: Eve (network), Bob (platform), Carol (runtime). Will include mitigation timeline, alert tuning, and playbook improvements (auto-divert threshold tuning, faster fallback spin-up).

Bob (Platform): action items: add circuit-level probing to routing controller, and pre-warm fallback dedicated nodes for regions with >10% traffic.

Eve (Ops): action items: vendor replacement parts on order, schedule on-site check for leaf 12. FAB-5477 updated.

Carol (Runtime): action items: add canary to fallback-variant pipeline to reduce token-cost surprises.

Dave (Support): will follow up with customer success to coordinate outreach for impacted customers.

Alice (SRE): closing on-channel updates. If anyone sees anomalies, re-open PD. Thanks for fast coordination :heart: 

Olivia (PM): thanks all. We'll sync tomorrow for the postmortem review.
